params.prompt: Create a natural 8-second vertical ecommerce fashion video. @image1 is the four-panel camera plan. @image2, @image3, and @image4 are the authoritative product photos. Show one consistent synthetic fashion model wearing the exact LEVI'S 90s Trucker jacket in Soft As Butter from the product photos, styled with the same simple white tank and black jeans. Preserve the light faded blue denim wash, relaxed oversized trucker shape, pointed collar, silver-tone button front, buttoned cuffs, chest flap pockets, side welt pockets, and buttoned hem tabs. Follow this motion: walk in from the left, pause front-facing, make one slow relaxed turn to show the side and back, then walk out toward the right. Keep hands away from the jacket details. Stable full-body camera, clean white studio, premium soft lighting, and natural denim movement. @audio1 is the exact instrumental soundtrack reference; keep it continuous and let the movement meet its pulse subtly without becoming dance-like. Closed-mouth neutral expression; no speaking, singing, lip-sync, mouth movement, presenter gestures, captions, logos, text, new accessories, garment changes, morphing, duplicate people, abrupt cuts, or framing that hides the jacket.
